title: Stress/conformance tests for KV cache compaction correctness (cancellation, streaming, churn, long-lived)
creator: Omar El-Sayed
description:
Context
We’re adding KV cache compaction + tier-aware eviction to reduce fragmentation and tail latency. This ticket adds stress + conformance coverage specifically for correctness hazards introduced by relocation/eviction under real runtime behaviors:
- Long-lived sessions (multi-hour chat / agent loops)
- Concurrent cancellations during relocation
- Partial streaming + mid-generation aborts
- Adversarial churn: heavy create/cancel cycles across mixed sequence lengths

These tests are release-gating for runtime-1.22 canary expansion.

Goals
1) Catch correctness bugs early (use-after-free, double-free, stale KV pointers, sequence state corruption, deadlocks).
2) Validate compaction/eviction invariants under cancellation + streaming + scheduler boundaries.
3) Provide reproducible, debuggable failures (seeded workloads, state snapshots, tracing markers).

Non-goals
- Proving perf improvements (covered by perf-canary + benchmark-lab tickets).
- UI/Console exposure of config knobs.

Test surface
- Runtime integration tests (preferred) + targeted unit tests for allocator invariants where needed.
- Must run in CI (smoke subset) + nightly (full stress).
- GPU required for full coverage; CPU-only “logic” mode acceptable where it can catch state machine errors.

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] CI: Add a deterministic smoke suite that runs <10 minutes and covers: cancellation during relocation, partial streaming abort, and basic churn (with compaction enabled).
- [ ] Nightly: Add stress suite that runs 30–60 minutes and covers: long-lived sessions, adversarial churn across mixed lengths, and concurrent client behaviors.
- [ ] Assertions/invariants: allocator + sequence invariants validated after every compaction step in test mode (or at least at safe points):
      - no duplicate page ownership
      - no pages referenced by completed/canceled sequences
      - relocation copies match expected token positions (where verifiable)
      - sequence state transitions remain valid (Prefill->Decode->Complete/Cancelled)
- [ ] Failure artifacts: on failure emit:
      - seed + workload config
      - allocator snapshot (free lists / arena occupancy / fragmentation ratio)
      - last N compaction/eviction events (ring buffer)
      - trace span IDs if tracing enabled
- [ ] Coverage: at least one test that reproduces the “cancel during relocation” class of bug fixed in PR-19440 (regression test).
- [ ] Document how to run locally and how to bisect flakes (README snippet or Confluence link).

Proposed test cases (initial)
A) CancelDuringRelocation_Stress
- Start N sequences; trigger compaction threshold; concurrently cancel random subset while relocation is in progress.
- Validate allocator invariants and no leaks.

B) StreamingAbort_PartialTokens
- Streaming enabled; abort mid-stream; ensure sequence teardown releases KV pages and does not block compaction worker.

C) LongLivedSessions_MixedDecode
- 1–5 “pinned” long-lived sessions + background churn from short sessions.
- Validate pinned sessions are never evicted; compaction should still make progress without starving decode.

D) AdversarialChurn_MixedLengths
- Mix: {very short, medium, very long prompts} and cancellations at adversarial boundaries (immediately after prefill, mid-decode, right at scheduler boundary).
- Ensure no stalls/deadlocks; verify compaction budget enforcement doesn’t break correctness.

E) TierAwareEviction_Safety
- With tier-aware eviction enabled: ensure only eligible sessions are evicted; pinned sessions and “non-preemptible” flows are respected.

Implementation notes
- Add a test-only hook to force compaction at deterministic points (e.g., "force_compact_now" or lower thresholds) to ensure reproduction.
- Prefer seeded RNG; include seed in test output.
- Use debug build flags for extra allocator checks where possible.

Links / references
- Design: sources/confluence/eng-serving-runtime/kernel-and-scheduling/kv-cache-compaction-design.json
- Metrics PR: sources/github/redwood/pr-19342-add-kv-fragmentation-counters.json
- Core allocator PR: sources/github/redwood/pr-19357-kv-cache-compaction-core-allocator-changes.json
- Scheduler integration PR: sources/github/redwood/pr-19371-scheduler-integration-compaction-budget.json
- Eviction PR: sources/github/redwood/pr-19388-tier-aware-eviction-policy.json
- Cancellation edge case fix: sources/github/redwood/pr-19440-fix-compaction-edge-case-cancelled-requests.json

Open questions
- Should nightly stress be split by GPU arch (A10 vs L4 vs H100) or just one representative? (Leaning: one representative + weekly broader sweep.)
- Where should allocator snapshots live (test logs vs artifact upload) and retention?

Rollout gating
- Must be green for 48h before enabling compaction by default in hosted canary cohort >5%.
